configuration.title: Meltemi Diagrams
config.language.description: The language of the canvas and of the extension's messages. Command titles and setting descriptions follow VS Code's display language.
config.language.enum.auto: VS Code's display language; English when it is not Spanish.
config.canvas.openWithText.description: When the canvas opens beside a .meltemi file.
config.canvas.openWithText.enum.remember: Open the canvas beside the code until you close it, and remember that choice.
config.canvas.openWithText.enum.always: Always open the canvas beside the code.
config.canvas.openWithText.enum.never: Open the canvas only when asked.
config.canvas.grid.description: Grid size of the canvas, in diagram units.
config.canvas.showGrid.description: Show the grid on the canvas.
config.canvas.snap.description: Snap moved and resized boxes to the grid.
config.canvas.guides.description: Snap to the edges and centres of other boxes, with alignment guides.
config.canvas.minimap.description: Show the minimap of the canvas.
config.canvas.inspector.description: Show the property inspector beside the canvas.
config.export.browser.markdownDescriptio: The Edge, Chrome or Chromium executable that captures PNG and PDF exports. Empty: an installed Edge or Chrome is found automatically.
config.export.ffmpeg.markdownDescription: The FFmpeg executable that encodes video exports (MP4, WebM, GIF). Empty: `ffmpeg` on the path. FFmpeg is not bundled.
config.assist.provider.markdownDescripti: Optional AI assistance. The key is kept in VS Code's secret storage (**Meltemi Diagrams: Set AI Key**) or the environment (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `MELTEMI_AI_API_KEY`), never in files. Validation, layout and export never use it.
config.assist.provider.enum.openaiCompat: A local or remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as Ollama
config.assist.model.markdownDescription: The model. Empty: `claude-opus-5-5` for Anthropic; required for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
config.assist.baseUrl.markdownDescriptio: The endpoint, such as `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1` for a local Ollama. Empty: Anthropic's API.
